snippet.title: Deleted childhood - Acid factory (demo)
snippet.description:
Deleted childhood is a series of videos of games that i (or we) played in the early 2000's, but unplayable today due to lack of support (Xtras plug-ins, Adobe Director).
I decided to record most of the games (some of them stopped working), before they completely stop working.
